description:
Embr brings Twitch to your Apple TV the way the big screen deserves: a fast, native app with live chat beside the video, emotes from 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ, and up to four streams at once.

WATCH
• Live streams, past broadcasts and clips in the Apple TV player, with picture in picture
• Chat beside the video, on the left or right, in three text sizes, with every emote and badge
• Past broadcasts replay their chat in sync and pick up where you left off
• Swipe up during a stream to switch to another channel that's live
• Back to Live whenever you fall behind, and a quality menu in the controls

DISCOVER
• Following and Favorites shelves of who's live, with short muted previews as you move across them
• Top streams and categories, search with dictation, and channel pages with past broadcasts and clips
• A Top Shelf of your live favorites and follows, previews included
• Multiview: two, three or four streams at once, the sound follows your focus

MADE FOR THE LIVING ROOM
• Sign in by scanning a code with your phone, no typing on the TV
• Everyone on your Apple TV gets their own sign-in and favorites
• Favorites sync with Embr on your iPhone and iPad through iCloud
• Light and dark, the chat filter and blocked users

FREE
Every feature is free for everyone, and Embr is one app across iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Founding Supporter is an optional one-time purchase that unlocks only looks, and you can try them all on first: a flame badge in your color, your name in that color or glowing and your founding number, seen by everyone watching in Embr, plus the OLED Black, Midnight, Ember and Dusk themes, seven accent colors, four chat fonts and app icons on iPhone. Watching never needs it.

———

Embr is an independent, third-party app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected to Twitch Interactive, Inc. "Twitch" and all related names, marks, and logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are used here only to describe what the app connects to. You sign in with your own Twitch account through Twitch's official OAuth; Embr never sees your password. Use of Twitch is subject to Twitch's own Terms of Service.
promotionalText: Twitch on the big screen: chat beside the video, multiview, live previews on Top Shelf and your favorites synced from iPhone.
